stats.notes: Figures from IPEDS, the US government's college data, via College Navigator (fall 2024 entering class). UCCS's 2025-26 Common Data Set PDF is an empty template and its 2024-25 Common Data Set keeps labels and values in separate text layers that cannot be matched reliably, so no Common Data Set figures are used. IPEDS gives 97% admitted (rounded), without the admit count; international applicant and admit counts, GPA and class-rank data are not shown. Undergraduate enrollment is fall 2024 (9,302). Test-score percentiles apply to enrolled first-time students. Applicant, admit and enrolled counts are the exact IPEDS figures for fall 2023, because the newer source gives only a rounded admit rate.

cds_test_policy.notes: UCCS admissions page: UCCS is test-optional; no minimum GPA or ACT/SAT requirement.

cost.notes: College Navigator (IPEDS) estimated expenses for full-time beginning undergraduates, 2024-25: tuition and fees in-state $10,149, out-of-state $24,336; on-campus food and housing $12,918; books $1,800; other $5,488. Current (2026-27) rates were not confirmed; the bursar's tuition pages and bill estimator carry them
